tagline: A shared space for autonomous work.
filter: Filter by title, capability or language
emptyHelp: Create a goal or register an agent to begin.
title: Title
name: Name
author: Author
topologyHelp: Nodes own clusters. Agents share tasks across node boundaries.
goalPlaceholder: Research competing Rust web frameworks and compare their tradeoffs.
tokenHelp: Sign in with the configured identity provider.
confirmCancel: Cancel this execution? Work already completed by tools remains.
agentHelp: Choose reusable Skills, then add your preferences and reference documents.
modelHelp: Register a provider endpoint and its model metadata.
answerHint: Enter text, or JSON containing result for tool reconciliation.
noModel: Register a model before creating an agent.
QUESTION: Question
abandonHelp: Records an explicit decision to skip this result. Answer the parent’s pending request to continue.
administratorsOnly: This page is available to administrators.
subject: Subject
accessDenied: Your current permissions do not allow this operation.
credentialInvalid: Your token is invalid, expired or revoked. Sign in with a current token.
generationHelp: Create specialists from approved definitions, with clear limits and a reviewable history.
generationTenantHelp: Open a tenant to manage its generation policies and requests.
generationNoPolicies: No enabled policy is available. Configure a generation policy before requesting a specialist.
generationNoRequests: No requests yet. Use policy assignment on an unassigned task to request an agent.
generationUnavailable: This request is no longer available with your current access.
generationModelHelp: Choose the approved model explicitly. Existing requests keep their selected definition.
generationMultiSelect: Use Command or Ctrl to select multiple tools or skills.
generationPermissionsHelp: Use existing roles and groups. Generated agents also inherit every originating subject’s restrictions.
generationBudgetHelp: Token budgets cover model input and output. Failed or uncertain calls can retain their full reservation.
generationAssignHelp: Reuse a matching approved agent, or generate a specialist under the selected policy. Activation may require approval.
generationPinnedPermissions: Permissions and limits pinned to this request
generationCompactionHelp: Choose an approved compaction Decider and call allowance for long histories. Failed and uncertain attempts consume calls. Every generated ancestor must approve the same Decider version.
deciderHelp: Register an exact Jev release such as typesafe/jev-1.14, then approve this version in the tenant catalog on each Node. Jev runs through OpenRouter with the Tenant's OpenRouter connection and zero data retention. With the Clef option, Cloudflare's Clef answers on Cloudflare, DeepInfra or PrimeIntellect only when Jev is unavailable. A Run whose Decider is unavailable pauses instead of being pruned.
deciderRetainState: Keep the classification state with each decision
transactionsHelp: Coordinate atomic changes across nodes. Changes stay hidden until every participant applies the committed decision.
transactionRecoveryHelp: Commit is irrevocable. Recovery continues until every participant releases its visibility barrier, even after the deadline.
transactionManifestHelp: Choose participants and resources by name, then review the operations before submitting.
transactionInvalid: Enter a JSON manifest containing participants.
transactionReviewHelp: Review the complete participant set and changes. Submission persists this immutable definition and begins coordination.
transactionWaitingHelp: Ordinary data is temporarily unavailable while an atomic transaction is unresolved. Transaction controls remain available; this screen retries automatically.
semanticHelp: Search authorized memories, messages and artifacts by meaning. Index status and source revisions remain visible.
semanticUnconfigured: No index configured for this workspace.
semanticDeleteHelp: Search stops returning this source immediately. Its vector is removed by durable cleanup. Runs that read it lose access to that source.
semanticConfigHelp: Changing configuration rebuilds the index in a new generation. Searches wait until authorized sources are ready. OpenRouter embeddings use the tenant's OpenRouter connection; OpenAI-compatible endpoints are called without a key.
semanticCleanupHelp: Retired identities are checked repeatedly to remove delayed writes.
semanticBackendFailure: Semantic backend unavailable or invalid. Inspect index status and retry.
semanticIncomplete: Indexing is incomplete. Inspect sources and retry when ready.
semanticIndexFailure: Embedding or vector service failed, or the source exceeds its input limit.
semanticSourceRevoked: Source permission was revoked or the source is unavailable.
semanticCredentialRevoked: Indexing credentials or policy no longer allow access.
semanticTombstoned: Source excluded from retrieval and queued for cleanup.
semanticSourceChanged: Source changed or permission restored; rebuilding.
semanticManagedSlot: This Agent memory is updated by the Agent memory tool.
semanticDeletedKey: Deleted source keys cannot be reused.
semanticRevisionChanged: The source or index changed. Reload and retry.
deploymentUnavailable: Deployment observations are unavailable. Check Kubernetes connectivity and service account permissions.
deploymentDisabled: Kubernetes observation is not configured for this node.
deploymentReadOnly: Manage rollout and scaling through your Kubernetes deployment configuration.
deploymentReconciling: The controller has not observed the latest configuration yet.
deploymentDraining: Terminating; current work is draining or awaiting recovery.
authorizationHelp: Manage tenant policy, test decisions, approve exact component versions and revoke subject credentials.
authMissingPolicy: No Tenant has this name. Aidash assigns Tenant names: create a Tenant above, then manage it by the name it receives.
authPolicyHelp: Define subjects, groups, role inheritance, allow/deny rules and attribute conditions. Access defaults to denied; an explicit deny overrides allows. The server validates references and cycles before saving.
authReviewHelp: Review the complete replacement below. This takes effect at the next authorization boundary, including running work and streams.
authInvalidBundle: Enter a policy object for this tenant, with object subjects/groups/roles and an array of policies.
authConflict: The revision changed. Your draft is retained. Close the editor, reload the latest policy and reconcile your changes before saving.
authJsonObject: Enter a valid JSON object for the attributes and environment.
authEvaluateHelp: Test the current saved policy against a scenario. A dry run writes no audit. These supplied attributes do not grant access; execution uses trusted stored attributes.
authRecordDecision: Save this decision to the audit history
authCredentialsHelp: The latest 200 credentials are listed without bearer secrets. Revocation applies to subsequent API, execution and stream boundaries.
authRevokeHelp: Revoke this specific credential. Subsequent authorized operations and stream deliveries using it will be rejected.
authTokenOnce: Save this token now. It is shown only here and is removed when you close this dialog or leave the page.
authKeylessNotice: Keyless endpoint: no zero-data-retention guarantee applies. Requests go outside Aidash's control to
authReason_tenant_mismatch: The resource belongs to another tenant.
authReason_delegation_denied: A delegation ancestor does not allow this action.
authReason_no_matching_allow: No allow rule matches this scenario.
authReason_explicit_deny: An explicit deny overrides matching allows.
authReason_allowed: The subject and its delegation chain allow this action.
generationEmbeddingHelp: Select an approved, immutable embedding provider matching the workspace index. Every generated ancestor must approve the same version. Query and indexing attempts consume call allowance and token budget; failures and uncertain usage retain their reservations.
embeddingRegistryHelp: Register the embedding provider, model/version and dimensions used by a semantic index. OpenRouter defaults to Gemini Embedding 2 with 3072 dimensions and uses the tenant's OpenRouter connection. Approve this exact component version for the tenant before selecting it in a generation policy.
authPeerMappingHelp: Bind one subject of a registered Node to a local credential, at one of this Tenant's Nodes. The Node must be registered there first. The receiving policy and catalog still control discovery.
authPeerMappingSaveHelp: Saving enables this mapping. Only active local credentials can be selected.
authPeerMappingDenied: The mapped credential is no longer authorized. Select an active credential and check its subject policy.
modelSearch: Search by model name or ID
modelCatalogStale: OpenRouter is not answering, so this list is the one fetched at
ownCredentialsHelp: Issue a token that acts as you in this Tenant, for the CLI or automation. A token ends when this Mapping is disabled or you leave the Tenant. You can hold at most 20 active tokens.
testLimitsHelp: Bound this Tenant's agent tests. Each value stays within the ceiling the Deployment sets, and a ceiling lowered later also lowers values already set.
testLimitsChanged: Someone else changed the limits. The latest values are shown; review them and save again.
testProfilesHelp: A profile lets agent tests call a Tool's read-only test endpoint instead of its production one. Set read_only_verified only after checking the endpoint yourself. A test endpoint reaches public addresses only, unless the Deployment permits its origin.
testProfileRulesArray: Enter a valid JSON array of rules.
modelLoadError: Could not load models. Please retry.
modelCatalogHelp: Choose a model supporting text input/output and tool calling with a published output limit. The registered limit is the model maximum.
modelChoose: Select a model from the list.
modelPricing: Indicative price per million tokens (USD, input / output):
modelZdr: Zero Data Retention is always enabled. Models without a ZDR endpoint cannot run.
modelTokenEncodingHelp: Choose an encoding only if this model uses it. Requests are then counted token by token; a wrong choice is detected and the Run falls back to bytes.
nodeNoConfiguration: No additional settings are needed for this registry entry. Node Registrations are managed under Settings, Nodes.
toolReplay_idempotent: Safe to repeat with the same request key (asks for approval)
toolReplayHelp: A version that declares it only reads needs no approval for its calls. Approving the version covers the declaration, and changing it needs a new version.
toolHintReadOnly: The server hints that this tool only reads, so "Reads only" is selected. A server's word never makes a tool read-only; you can change the choice.
toolHintWrites: The server hints that this tool may change things.
toolHintNone: The server gives no hint for this tool.
toolTaskArguments: Agent calls use task inputs: title and description are required; requirements, dependencies and a parent task are optional.
toolUrlArgument: The tool accepts a required URL argument. Only the allowed hosts can be requested.
agentSkillsHelp: Skills provide the working methods. Select the versions you want to use.
agentNoSkills: No Skills yet. Register a Skill using SKILL.md from the entity kind selector.
agentNeedsSkill: Select at least one Skill or enter additional instructions.
additionalInstructionsHelp: Your preferences, output format, and constraints
agentDocumentsHelp: Attach PDF, Excel (.xlsx), or text files. Extracted text is saved privately on this node for this agent and sent to its model during execution. Original files, images, formatting, and formula recalculation are not retained. Up to 8 files, 10 MiB each, 64 KiB extracted text total.
documentEmpty: No text found. Scanned PDFs need OCR first.
documentFileLimit: File exceeds 10 MiB or 200 PDF pages.
documentTextLimit: Extracted text exceeds 64 KiB. Attach a smaller excerpt.
documentReadError: Could not read this file. Check its format and password protection.
skillImportHelp: Enter a public GitHub repository, Skill directory, SKILL.md page or raw URL, or skills.sh Skill page. Supporting files are imported too. Review the instructions, files, and license before registering. Bundled scripts are stored and are not executed automatically.
skillImportError: Use a SKILL.md under 64 KiB with valid name and description YAML fields and Markdown instructions.
transactionRemoteReferenceHelp: Peer resources are not in this node's snapshot. Enter their references and revisions from that peer.
transactionRevocationPending: New admissions are denied after revocation. Some previously issued admission attempts still need a durable result; revocation remains pending until they are reconciled.
providerCredentialsHelp: Connect OpenRouter through its consent page to give this tenant a Provider Credential. Aidash never shows or accepts the key itself. Bind an active Provider Credential to OpenRouter before admitting runs.
providerCredentialsDisabled: Secret Store is not configured on this node.
providerConnectionsHelp: OpenRouter issues a key to this tenant after you approve on its consent page. Aidash stores the key without showing it. Reconnecting issues a new key and rotates the Provider Credential.
providerConnectionOutcome_unbound: OpenRouter issued and Aidash stored a new key, but it is not bound to this Tenant, so Runs keep using the current binding. Choose the key under Provider Credential bindings if Runs should use it.
providerConnectionOutcome_reconnected: OpenRouter was reconnected with a new key.
providerConnectionOutcome_reconnectedPre: OpenRouter was reconnected with a new key. The previous key stays valid at OpenRouter until you delete it there.
providerConnectionKeyWarnings: OpenRouter reported a warning for the connected key, such as a missing spending limit. Review the key with “Manage key at OpenRouter”.
providerConnectionOutcome_denied: OpenRouter authorization was declined. Nothing was stored.
providerConnectionOutcome_failed: OpenRouter authorization failed. Nothing was stored; try again.
providerConnectionOutcome_failedIssued: OpenRouter issued a key, but Aidash could not store it. The key stays valid at OpenRouter until you delete it there; then try again.
providerCredentialRevokedNotice: Aidash deleted its copy of the key. The key stays valid at OpenRouter until you delete it there.
contextOnUnavailableHint: Applies only to local Runs, after five retries. Required-Home Runs always pause.
runDegradedContextHint: Workspace semantic context was unavailable in these steps, so the model received an unavailable marker instead.
catalogHelp: Approve this exact version so this Tenant can use it. Use also needs policy permission.
catalogBuiltinHelp: Built-in definitions need no Catalog Approval.
catalogInstalledHelp: An installed Marketplace copy is approved by activating its installation in the Marketplace.
catalogAgentDefault: Approval makes this agent a subject of this Tenant in the members group.
catalogAgentGroupsHelp: Approval makes this agent a subject of this Tenant in the groups you choose. They start from the latest approved earlier version.
catalogSubjectKept: Approving again keeps the existing subject and its groups.
catalogDependenciesHelp: This version needs definitions this Tenant has not approved. Approve them together with it in one request.
catalogConflict: The approval changed. Review the current state and try again.
catalogTenantDefinitions: Definitions belong to Tenants. Each Tenant registers and approves its own in its Registry.
catalogRegistryUnavailable: The Registry is unavailable with your current access.
deciderClefRoute: Ask Cloudflare's Clef (on Cloudflare, DeepInfra or PrimeIntellect) when Jev is unavailable
catalogReadOnlyNotice: This version declares that its calls only read, so they need no Tool call approval. Approving the version approves that declaration.
agentPluginImportHelp: Enter a public GitHub repository, or a directory or plugin.json page in it, that holds an Agent Plugin. Aidash copies the plugin at its current commit. Review its Skills, servers and skipped parts before adding it to the Agent.
agentPluginRuntime: A stdio server runs code in a sandbox, and only after the Tenant approves the built-in mcp_stdio group. A remote server is called from the server, and each of its tool calls needs a Tool call approval.
agentPluginError: The plugin could not be imported.
agentPluginNotFound: No Agent Plugin was found at this URL.
agentPluginUnreadable: The server answered with a plugin this form cannot read.
agentPluginLimit: An Agent takes in at most 8 plugins.
agentPluginIgnoredHelp: These have no effect. The plugin still loads.
agentPluginSkippedHelp: These components are left out. The rest of the plugin loads.
agentPluginDenied: Paths left out because they lead outside the plugin
catalogAgentPluginsAdmit: Approving this version admits the servers its plugins declare.
nodesHelp: Nodes are this Tenant's agent hubs. A Workspace, its Runs and its Catalog Approvals belong to one Node. Choose the Node you work in here or in the account menu.
nodesTenantOnly: Nodes belong to a Tenant. Choose a Tenant authority to see its Nodes.
nodeLabelHelp: The label is only for people: Aidash names a Node itself, and the name never changes.
nodeConflict: The Node Registration changed since you loaded it. Reload and try again.
nodeDenied: Your policy does not allow this change.
nodeKeyIdHelp: The other Deployment shows its key ID at /.well-known/aidash. Registering pins the key it publishes, and a request signed by another key is refused.
nodeRegistrationsHelp: A Node Registration lets this Node accept exchange from one Node of another Tenant, and address requests to it. Nodes of this Tenant need none. Map the registered Node's subjects under Peer identity mappings.
nodeRegistrationNone: No Node is registered at this Node.
nodeRegistrationDashboardOriginHelp: Pin the other Deployment's dashboard origin to allow its subjects to frame File and Live previews from this Node.
nodeRegistrationAtomicHelp: Let this Node take part in atomic transactions with the owning Node.
receivingKeyHelp: Quarantine stops new requests using this record. To confirm a key, obtain its key ID through a separate trusted channel and enter its public PEM. Permissions and enabled state stay as they are.
receivingKeyDisabled: This record is disabled. Confirming a key keeps it disabled.
receivingKeyIndependent: I checked the key ID through a separate trusted channel
receivingKeyConflict: The record changed. Review its current key and confirm again.
receivingKeyDeletedHelp: Manage existing foreign registrations of deleted Nodes while their catalog records remain. This does not restore a Node or enable a registration.
receivingKeyKnownHelp: Enter the receiving Node's permanent name and the original source Node address. Your current permissions must allow this exact registration. After the Node's catalog entry expires, only registrations still needed for recovery can be managed. This does not restore a Node or enable a registration.
nodeLifecycleHelp: Move the default to another live Node before deletion. The last live Node cannot be deleted. Restoring uses current capacity and permissions; it does not restart cancelled work or restore revoked access.
nodeConfirmName: Type the Node name to confirm
nodeDeleteNotice: Deleting immediately closes this Node and cancels its work. Its capacity slot is released. Data stays recoverable during this Deployment’s Node grace period, fixed at deletion. The Node name is never reused.
nodePurgeNotice: Purge permanently removes this Node’s data. Once purge starts, the Node cannot be restored. Shared Tenant data and limited administration history remain.
nodeStorageNotice: Files remain stored until physical purge.
nodeDeploymentAdministratorRestore: Only a Deployment Administrator can restore this Node.
nodeRestoreConflict: Restore was refused. Check the current Node capacity, restore deadline and purge progress before trying again.
nodeLifecycleConflict: The Node changed or this action is no longer allowed. Review its current default and lifecycle state.
nodeStoredAmountUnavailable: Stored amount is unavailable. Refresh before confirming.
nodeStorageSelfHosted: Self-hosted has no Aidash usage bill. Files remain stored until physical purge.
nodeStorageCloud: Retained storage remains billable until physical purge. Storage charges continue under the current Cloud billing terms.
nodeStorageDedicated: Dedicated meters and reports usage under your contract until physical purge. This view does not calculate a storage charge.
nodeStorageOfferingUnknown: Current Offering is unavailable. This view cannot determine the applicable storage charge. Files remain stored until physical purge.
nodeStorageExemption: Node deletion does not change the applicable storage billing rules. If the Tenant itself is deleted, its existing storage exemption still applies.
keylessEndpointHelp: Keyless endpoints receive no credential. Review the endpoint and its data retention policy before use. Default limits are 128000 context tokens and 16384 output tokens; review them for this model.
filePreviewTooLargeBody: This File version is larger than the 16 MiB File preview limit. Download it to inspect it.
filePreviewUnsupportedBody: This format has no File preview here. Download the file to inspect it.
filePreviewPreviewDomainBody: HTML and PDF File previews open from the preview domain. The dashboard does not render them.
filePreviewPreviewDomainUnavailable: This Deployment has no preview domain configured, so this File version has no File preview here. Download it to inspect it.
filePreviewMarkdownNotUtf8: This Markdown file is not UTF-8, so it cannot be shown as a File preview. Download it to inspect it.
filePreviewMarkdownImageRefused: Image not shown: it is not a sibling File version of this revision.
filePreviewMarkdownImageMissing: Image not shown: it is not available in this revision.
filePreviewMarkdownImageTooLarge: Image not shown: it is larger than the 16 MiB File preview limit.
filePreviewMarkdownImageNotImage: Image not shown: this File version is not an image.
filePreviewSpreadsheetLoading: Reading the spreadsheet off the main thread…
filePreviewSpreadsheetSimplified: Simplified view: stored values only. Formulas are not recalculated, and charts, images, macros and active links are not shown.
filePreviewSpreadsheetEmpty: This sheet has no stored values.
filePreviewSpreadsheetTooLarge: This File version is larger than the 16 MiB File preview limit. Download it to inspect it.
filePreviewSpreadsheetNotUtf8: This CSV file is not UTF-8. To avoid showing garbage, it has no File preview here; download it and open it in its original encoding.
filePreviewSpreadsheetRowsLimit: This sheet exceeds the File preview row limit (10,000 rows). Download the file to inspect every row.
filePreviewSpreadsheetCellsLimit: This sheet exceeds the File preview cell limit (200,000 cells). Download the file to inspect every cell.
filePreviewSpreadsheetColumnsLimit: This sheet exceeds the File preview column limit (1,000 columns). Download the file to inspect every column.
filePreviewSpreadsheetParseError: The spreadsheet could not be read for its File preview. Download the file to inspect it.
filePreviewPaneFetchError: Could not load this File version for its File preview.
filePreviewPaneChanged: This File version changed after the file list loaded. Close the pane and open the current version.
filePreviewPaneDownloadError: Could not download this File version.
fileCitationLimit: A message can cite up to 8 File versions.
fileCitationQuota: This message cannot retain one of its cited File versions because the Tenant quota is full. Send it without the citations, or free space and try again.
filePreviewCheckingAvailability: Checking whether this Deployment has a preview domain…
filePreviewCitedCurrentSiblings: This is a cited File version. Its Markdown images are resolved from the current Working Area version.
filePreviewCitedPinnedUnavailable: This is a cited File version and its pinned manifest is unavailable, so sibling images are not shown.
filePreviewNoAccessNow: You no longer have access to this File version.
filePreviewPreviewDomainDesktopBody: The desktop app opens HTML and PDF File previews in your system browser.
filePreviewPreviewUnavailable: The preview domain is not available right now. Try again later.
filePreviewTicketError: Could not open this File preview. Try again.
filePreviewVersionReleased: This File version is no longer retained.
filePreviewVersionTooLarge: This File version is too large for its File preview.
livePreviewStop_replaced: Replaced by a newer Live preview
livePreviewNone: This Run has no Live preview.
livePreviewStatusUnavailable: Live preview status is temporarily unavailable. Retrying.
livePreviewStaleHelp: A newer version exists; the next turn restarts it.
livePreviewUnavailable: This Deployment has no preview domain configured, so Live previews are unavailable.
livePreviewDesktopBody: The desktop app opens Live previews in your system browser.
livePreviewTicketGone: This Live preview is no longer available.
livePreviewLimitsHelp: Set this Tenant's Live preview idle and absolute limits within the Deployment ceilings. Values may only be lowered, and the idle limit cannot outlast the absolute limit.
livePreviewLimitsChanged: Someone else changed the limits. The latest values are shown; review them and save again.
remotePreviewInspectionUnavailable: The remote Run's File versions and Live preview could not be inspected.
remotePreviewDomainUnavailable: This remote Node has no preview domain. Its File versions and Live preview cannot be opened here.
remotePreviewNoFiles: No File versions are available for this Run.
